summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Alice Clere (died 1538), giving her parentage and family relations. She was the daughter of Sir William Boleyn and Margaret Ormond (otherwise Butler), who was the daughter and co-heiress of Thomas Butler, 7th Earl of Ormond. Through this lineage she was the sister of Thomas Boleyn, 1st Earl of Wiltshire, and the aunt of Anne Boleyn, the second queen of King Henry VIII.
one_line: Alice Clere (died 1538) was an English noblewoman, daughter of Sir William Boleyn and aunt of Anne Boleyn.
key_facts: Alice Clere was the daughter of Sir William Boleyn and his wife Margaret Ormond (otherwise Butler).
Margaret Ormond (otherwise Butler) was the daughter and co-heiress of Thomas Butler, 7th Earl of Ormond.
Alice Clere was the sister of Thomas Boleyn, 1st Earl of Wiltshire.
Alice Clere was the aunt of Anne Boleyn, the second Queen of King Henry VIII.
